piece.purpose: Authoritative build definition and permanent game-resource identity for DD RHW-4 Level 1 (7.5 m) and Level 2 (15 m) over GHSR Ground (1 m) — Mixed Crossing — Both Diagonal 90°.
piece.name: DD RHW-4 Level 1 (7.5 m) and Level 2 (15 m) over GHSR Ground (1 m) — Mixed Crossing — Both Diagonal 90°
piece.description: Two fixed tiles carry both directions of diagonal ground high-speed rail beneath the two diagonal DD RHW-4 decks. Four unowned native approach tiles seed actual NAM draggable continuation. Rail and highway have independent through routes.

provenance.geometry: Pinned NAM 50 native six-mesh DD halves and ordinary GHSR valid track mesh.
provenance.construction: Two protected DirtRoad/Monorail cells; four disjoint dynamic native helpers; four proper rotations repeated.
